description: Dependency updates (ADR 0031). The same file in every repository.
Three self-hosted runners on one machine serve them all, so updates come once a week, grouped,
and a major update waits for approval on the dependency dashboard.

nix.description: flake.lock is updated by lock file maintenance, with Cargo.lock.

rust-toolchain.description: Toolchains are bumped deliberately: stable follows itself, and the fuzzing nightly is pinned.

packageRules.description: iroh is the wire, so it comes in its own pull request.
The monorepo release that infra runs, and the relay built to match it, are bumped deliberately with each release (as is the app's, which Renovate does not see).
